## 0.48.0

The crowd pipeline wave - your scans now become everyone's data, plus an opt-in way to show off.

**Verified rules, no scanning needed.** Talents whose rank scaling has been crowd-verified now show a green "rank rule crowd-verified" line instead of "(p) presumed" - even on a brand-new character. Your own scans still override on your own client, always.

**Zero-click verify.** Open your talent tree and Foresight now scans the talents you've trained automatically (out of combat) - no hover, no command. Turn it off with `/foresight set autoVerify off`.

**Show yourself on the ladders (opt-in, off by default).** Run `/foresight set named on` and pick a handle, and when you Contribute you can appear by that handle on the public champion ladders (Biggest Armor, Biggest Earth Shock, and more) at wow-foresight.web.app - with the buffs you had shown, so records are honest. Everyone else stays anonymous; their numbers still count toward the averages. It's a nickname you choose, never your real name, and you can turn it off anytime.

**Know your gaps.** `/foresight coverage` shows how much of the all-class talent roster you've captured and verified, and which classes you still haven't seen - inspect players of those classes to fill them in.

Plus a privacy-safety hardening under the hood: the list of what can ever leave your machine now lives in one place, so it can't drift.
